cohort: Women with severe preeclampsia (blood pressure of at least 160/110 mm Hg after 24 weeks and either proteinuria, platelet count <100,000, or serum transaminase levels twice normal) attending Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College, Aligarh, India, between January 2013 and September 2014.
finding: Discontinuing magnesium sulfate immediately after delivery was as effective as continuing it for 24 hours in preventing convulsions in women with severe preeclampsia.
followup_time: Until completion of magnesium sulfate therapy (immediately postpartum in the intervention group, 24 hours postpartum in the control group)
